Hi Kimberly / Karthik,

Thanks for the draft order form (attached). A couple of finance questions came up on our end as we prepare the PO:

- Which Redwood legal entity will issue the invoices? We have a US entity and an EU entity on file and need to route invoices to the correct AP contact.

We want to avoid re-issuing POs once invoices start flowing. Can you confirm and send any tax evidence we should attach to our PO?

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Invoicing entity: Redwood issues commercial invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) by default. For EU invoicing we can route through Redwood Inference EU Ltd if required, but that requires an entity-level contract mapping on the order form.

2) VAT / tax evidence: we can provide a tax residency letter and (if needed) a certificate of tax residency for Redwood Inference EU Ltd. I will loop in Marissa for the formal evidence packet.

3) Net terms: our standard for this deal is Net 45 as quoted. We can do Net 30 if invoices are routed to the US entity and finance approves — request will need an internal finance lead sign-off and may affect early-payment credits.

Small ask: can you confirm the AP contact, PO number, and whether the billing should be split between US and EU entities (e.g., usage in EU -> EU invoice)? If you prefer, we can split invoices by product lines or by monthly tranche.

I'll coordinate with Legal on doing the order form amendment to map entity and with Finance to confirm whether Net 30 can be approved. Expected follow-up by Tuesday.

Attachment: (draft) Acme_OrderForm_v3.pdf referenced above
